title: Track 3 physical verification layer
objective: Independently verify large computational facilities using physical observations, remote sensing, infrastructure records and construction/power chronology without treating any missing layer as evidence of absence.

checklist.coverage: 196 raw Sentinel-2 COG windows processed; scene provenance and compact metrics are stored, full rasters are not stored in Git.
176 Landsat ST scene observations processed with local-background thermal metrics.
179 Sentinel-1 GRD scene observations processed with VV/VH backscatter and temporal deltas.
90 project/evidence records mention substations, but automated site-level expansion detection has not been performed.
3 source-backed transformer procurement/delivery/specification event records are retained; the 93-site research queue remains published for uncovered sites.
113 project/evidence records contain transmission-line/project references, but site-level construction-event detection is not yet computationally linked.
2 Epoch sites currently have structured cooling-equipment snapshots. Other sites remain not ingested.
No structured site-level generator/backup-generation observation is currently linked to the 93 Epoch IDs.
33 public permit records are ingested in the broader project layer, but they are not yet exhaustively site-linked to every Epoch facility.
88 sites have multi-temporal optical observations for coarse campus-change proxy analysis; polygonized footprints remain separate.
93 / 93 Epoch sites have construction timeline records with dated power/IT-power fields retained.

summary.semantics: Source availability is not ingestion. External project/permit evidence is not treated as a site match until a physical-site linkage exists.
summary.derived_observation_semantics: Derived-observation count is read from the retained remote-sensing observation ledger. It is distinct from raw scene/window counts above and does not imply AI compute.
